verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
To be Your bread now
Be Your wine now

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Lord come and change us
To be a sign of Your love

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Blessed and broken
Poured and flowing

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
Gift that you gave us
To be Your body once again

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We come to Your table with our lives
as they are

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Heal us Lord, for we are broken
Make us one again

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: Lord, we stumble through the darkness of night

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Lead us now, Lord we follow
Bring us home to You

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines: Give us the bread and wine that brings us to life

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Feed us and we'll never hunger
Never thirst again
